title: Understand the Parabola Shape
text: The coefficient of $x^2$ is positive (+1), so the parabola opens UPWARD.\n\nThis means the expression is NEGATIVE (below x-axis) BETWEEN the roots.

title: Test a Value
text:
Test $x = 0$ (between -1 and 5):

$0^2 - 4(0) - 5 = -5 < 0$ ✓

So values between -1 and 5 satisfy the inequality.

title: Write the Solution
text:
Since we need $x^2 - 4x - 5 < 0$ (strictly less than), we exclude the endpoints.

$$-1 < x < 5$$

Or in interval notation: $$(-1, 5)$$
